productLocalePolicy.unsupportedExplicitSelection: reject selection and retain current valid locale; do not mark planned/backlog locale as enabled only because it exists in registry
productLocalePolicy.unsupportedAccountPreferenceOnRead: use en-IN fallback and record a safe TEST-only diagnostic without user-sensitive data
productLocalePolicy.unsupportedPreferenceWrite: reject with a stable validation error code; never trust an arbitrary locale string
productLocalePolicy.missingTranslation: try en-IN dictionary; if still missing, use a supplied safe fallback or approved generic display copy; do not render raw internal translation key
productLocalePolicy.mobileWebDictionaryMerge: prohibited without an explicit canonical key mapping and review; current catalogs are materially different

beforeAuthentication: supported device locale if local selection absent/invalid
afterAuthentication: if the user explicitly changed language during the current session, preserve that choice and synchronize it to the account preference when the approved API is available
otherwise apply the account saved preference if it is supported
if account preference is missing/unsupported, preserve the valid local selection and synchronize it after login
if local selection is also missing/invalid, use supported device locale or en-IN
selectionAndSync.localSelectionBehavior: apply immediately without network dependency; persistence failure must not crash the UI
selectionAndSync.syncFailureBehavior: do not revert the current UI language; show a non-blocking sync warning and retry through a bounded idempotent sync mechanism after network recovery
selectionAndSync.serverRouteStatus: NOT_ESTABLISHED; verify existing profile/preferences routes before adding a duplicate API
selectionAndSync.acceptLanguageHeader: may advertise current locale to Backend for human-readable responses; stable codes and structured params remain the UI contract

firstLaunchResolver.precedence: See contract; explicit session choice > saved account preference (authenticated) > local preference > supported device locale > en-IN fallback as applicable
firstLaunchResolver.deviceRegionMapping: Different region for supported base language maps to configured Indian locale; explicit different script is rejected.

localPreferencePersistence.failureBehavior: Non-fatal status; resolved language remains selected and UI must not crash.

preferencePrecedenceGuard.behavior: Account preference reads with stale generation or a current explicit selection cannot override current locale; write responses never change current UI locale.

implementation.legacyMigration: Mobile reads ridex.language.preference.v1 only when canonical key is absent; Admin Web migrates ridex-admin-language:<environment> into canonical key.
implementation.firstLaunch: Supported device locale (English/Hindi) is resolved after local preference; en-IN is fallback. Explicit user selection applies immediately and stale startup persistence is generation guarded.
